definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to words to indicate a room for a specific purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}{室|しつ}→休憩室：23410_kyuukeishitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: To rest in the break room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}{室|しつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
⟦{待合|まちあい}{室|しつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait in the waiting room.

notes:
{室|しつ} is a suffix meaning 'room' attached to nouns to indicate a room designated for a specific purpose. It is more formal than ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}{室|しつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧: meeting room, conference room
- ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}{室|しつ}→休憩室：23410_kyuukeishitsu⟧: break room, rest room
- ⟦{待合|まちあい}{室|しつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧: waiting room
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}{室|しつ}→研究室：01397_kenkyuushitsu⟧: research lab, study
- ⟦{応接|おうせつ}{室|しつ}→応接室：20242_ousetsushitsu⟧: reception room
- ⟦{図書|としょ}{室|しつ}→図書室：05381_toshoshitsu⟧: library room
- {教{室|しつ}|きょうしつ}: classroom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {室|しつ}: room (suffix, formal, purpose-specific)
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: room (standalone word, general)
- {間|ま}: room (traditional Japanese rooms, e.g., ⟦{茶|ちゃ}の{間|ま}→茶の間：10660_chanoma⟧)

The kanji can also be read むろ in some words, but しつ is the standard suffix reading.
